assets.observations: Natural camera-like workshop surfaces and unpatterned scalp. One focused smiling craftsman works a fine heated metal point and pincers at blue cloisonne cells. Whole shallow dish, both working hands and face remain clearly visible within the current 0.45-feather mask. Dish is modest relative to the adult hands, no oversized prop. Quiet outer workshop/foreground margins are intentionally allowed to disappear. No oval/frame/text overlays in JPG. First attempt preserved but not selected because its right dish rim faded excessively.

Complete vertical flexible hanging scroll with suspension, ivory mounting and dark bottom roller, physical brush calligraphy and adult scholar beside it. Different standing composition from seated workshop. Plain face/skin, ordinary fabric, light natural room. Full scroll silhouette, face and brush hand remain readable under broad current 0.45 mask. Uses base text fallback, without the unrelated Puyi/teacher version stories. Physical classical characters are in-scene ink, not overlay captions. First attempt preserved but not selected because scroll top was lost in mask.
